mapper.sql: id, project_id, name, status, environment_key, trigger_policy_json::text as trigger_policy_json, dag_digest, description, created_by, updated_by, archived_at, created_at, updated_at

id, plan_id, node_key, node_type, array_to_string(dependency_keys, ',') as dependency_keys_csv, input_summary_json::text as input_summary_json, failure_policy, timeout_seconds, retry_policy_json::text as retry_policy_json, created_at, updated_at

id, plan_id, project_id, status, trigger_type, request_key, source_event_id, attempt, trace_id, result_summary_json::text as result_summary_json, error_code, error_summary, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at

nr.id, nr.run_id, nr.plan_node_id, nr.status, nr.attempt, nr.runner_type, nr.external_run_id, nr.error_code, nr.error_summary, nr.result_summary_json::text as result_summary_json, nr.heartbeat_at, nr.queued_at, nr.started_at, nr.finished_at, nr.created_at, nr.updated_at
id, node_run_id, claim_token, worker_id, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, expires_at, status, created_at, updated_at

id, plan_id, trigger_type, status, config_digest, config_summary_json::text as config_summary_json, secret_ref, secret_ref_digest, next_fire_at, last_fire_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
id, trigger_id, source_event_id, request_digest, status, run_id, received_at, error_code, error_summary, trace_id

where.if: and ( position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(name, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(description, ''))) > 0 )

mapper.update: update execution_plan set name = #{name}, status = #{status}, environment_key = #{environmentKey}, trigger_policy_json = cast(coalesce(#{triggerPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), dag_digest = #{dagDigest}, description = #{description}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
update execution_plan set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status != 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.insert: insert into execution_plan_node ( id, plan_id, node_key, node_type, dependency_keys, input_summary_json, failure_policy, timeout_seconds, retry_policy_json, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{planId}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeType}, case when #{dependencyKeysCsv} is null or #{dependencyKeysCsv} = '' then '{}'::text[] else string_to_array(#{dependencyKeysCsv}, ',')::text[] end, cast(coalesce(#{inputSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{failurePolicy}, #{timeoutSeconds}, cast(coalesce(#{retryPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update execution_run set status = #{status}, trigger_type = #{triggerType}, request_key = #{requestKey}, source_event_id = #{sourceEventId}, attempt = #{attempt}, trace_id = #{traceId}, result_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{resultSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, created_by = #{createdBy}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update execution_node_run set status = #{status}, attempt = #{attempt}, runner_type = #{runnerType}, external_run_id = #{externalRunId}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, result_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{resultSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, queued_at = #{queuedAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update execution_node_run set status = #{nodeRun.status}, attempt = #{nodeRun.attempt}, runner_type = #{nodeRun.runnerType}, external_run_id = #{nodeRun.externalRunId}, error_code = #{nodeRun.errorCode}, error_summary = #{nodeRun.errorSummary}, result_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{nodeRun.resultSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), heartbeat_at = #{nodeRun.heartbeatAt}, queued_at = #{nodeRun.queuedAt}, started_at = #{nodeRun.startedAt}, finished_at = #{nodeRun.finishedAt}, updated_at = #{nodeRun.updatedAt} where id = #{nodeRun.id} and status = #{expectedStatus}

update execution_trigger set status = #{status}, config_digest = #{configDigest}, config_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{configSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), secret_ref = #{secretRef}, secret_ref_digest = #{secretRefDigest}, next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, last_fire_at = #{lastFireAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update execution_trigger_event set request_digest = #{requestDigest}, status = #{status}, run_id = #{runId}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, trace_id = #{traceId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from execution_plan_node where plan_id = #{planId} order by node_key asc

select from execution_plan
order by updated_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from execution_plan
select from execution_node_run nr join execution_plan_node pn on pn.id = nr.plan_node_id where nr.run_id = #{runId} order by pn.node_key asc, nr.attempt asc

select from execution_node_run nr join execution_run er on er.id = nr.run_id join execution_plan_node pn on pn.id = nr.plan_node_id where nr.status = 'QUEUED' and er.status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') order by er.created_at asc, pn.node_key asc, nr.attempt asc limit #{limit}
select from execution_queue_claim where node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} and status = 'CLAIMED' order by claimed_at desc limit 1
select from execution_queue_claim where claim_token = #{claimToken} limit 1

select from execution_node_run nr join execution_run er on er.id = nr.run_id where nr.status = 'RUNNING' and er.status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') and coalesce(nr.started_at, nr.created_at) <= #{deadline} order by coalesce(nr.started_at, nr.created_at) asc limit #{limit}

select from execution_run
order by created_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from execution_run

select from execution_trigger
order by updated_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from execution_trigger
select p.project_id from execution_trigger t join execution_plan p on p.id = t.plan_id where t.id = #{id}

select from execution_trigger_event
order by received_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from execution_trigger_event
